headword.status_note: 此处标示英语中的规范形式；现有材料不足以将其确认为标准马来语词。音标为英式英语重读形式，弱读为 /wə/。

morphology.formula: 英语 be 的不规则屈折变化 → were；不适用马来语词缀分析
morphology.pattern_note: is_root 与 root_word 保留输入记录的分析结果；英语语法上的原形实际为 be。were 是单音节，词尾 e 不单独发音。

word_family.gloss: 英语原形：是；处于某状态
英语 be 的另一过去式

senses.zh_definition: 英语动词 be 的过去时形式，用于 you、we、they 及复数主语；可表示过去的状态，也可构成过去进行时或被动语态。
senses.en_definition: The past indicative form of be used with you and plural subjects, as a main verb or auxiliary.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk kala lampau kata kerja bahasa Inggeris be bagi subjek you dan subjek jamak; digunakan sebagai kata kerja utama atau kata kerja bantu.
senses.nuances: 这是英语语法项目，没有固定的一对一马来语译词。下列 ms 栏呈现英语搭配原文，供识别外语形式，并非马来语搭配。[American Heritage Dictionary](https://www.ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=were)

senses.zh_definition: 英语 be 表示非现实假设或愿望的形式，可与单数或复数主语连用，不一定表示过去时间。
senses.en_definition: A form of be expressing an unreal or hypothetical situation or a wish.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk kata kerja bahasa Inggeris be yang menyatakan keadaan andaian atau keinginan yang tidak nyata, termasuk dengan subjek tunggal.
senses.nuances: 常见于 if I were you 和 I wish ... were ...；此时不能机械地译为过去发生。下列搭配为英语原文。[Collins English Dictionary](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/us/dictionary/english/were)

dual_scenarios.context: 职场英语培训 / 语法说明
dual_scenarios.ms: Dalam ayat bahasa Inggeris itu, were digunakan kerana subjeknya ialah they.
dual_scenarios.zh: 在那个英语句子中，由于主语是 they，因此使用 were。
dual_scenarios.en: In that English sentence, were is used because the subject is they.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 朋友讨论英语作业
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku dah tukar was kepada were kat ayat tu.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya sudah menukar was kepada were dalam ayat itu.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我已经把那句里的 was 改成 were 了。
dual_scenarios.en: I've changed was to were in that sentence.
spoken_features: aku 为熟人间的第一人称
were 作为被讨论的英语形式出现

messages.speaker: Farah (同学)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku dah guna were kat ayat ni. Betul tak?
messages.ms_standard: Saya sudah menggunakan were dalam ayat ini. Adakah penggunaannya betul?
messages.zh: 我这句已经用 were 了，对吗？
messages.en: I've used were in this sentence. Is that right?

messages.speaker: Amir (同学)
messages.ms_spoken: Betul, sebab subjeknya they. Kekalkan je were tu.
messages.ms_standard: Betul, kerana subjeknya ialah they. Kekalkan penggunaan were itu.
messages.zh: 对，因为主语是 they。保留 were 就行。
messages.en: Yes, because the subject is they. Just keep were.

etymology.historical_story: English were continues Middle English were and weren, which developed from Old English forms including wǣre and wǣron. It preserves an older distinction within the unusually irregular verb be. Its appearance in Malaysian multilingual writing can therefore represent English material rather than a Malay derivative; this packet alone does not establish a separate Malay word. [American Heritage Dictionary](https://www.ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=were)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 you were、we were、they were 连成一组记；看到 if I were，再切换到“假如”的画面。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 讨论英语时可在马来语句子中引用 were；向学习者解释时，应明确它属于英语。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 正式马来语行文中，仅在引用、教学或讨论英语原文时保留 were；根据整句意思表达过去状态或假设，不能一律替换成 adalah。
